store: Smith's Drawers, working timber scoops, Sol 6.1 / extra high
space: Unity prefab space, origin = the carcass's footprint centre on the ground (the pulled drawers reach 0.26 m in front of it). Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity y-up/+z front: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ export (forward NEGATIVE_Z, up Y) writes (bx, bz, -by); Unity's importer negates x, same mapping.
unit_semantics: SETTLED: every copy has an explicit final pose from a rigid-body simulation (convex-hull items, friction 0.75, restitution 0), dropped in batches onto the frozen earlier copies; each drawer's copy sequence is cut into its units in drop order. Each copy: the item's bounds centre at unit.position + copy.offset (= copy.world_position), rotated by copy.quat_xyzw (or copy.euler, Unity ZXY), longest side fit_longest_m. unit.position = centre of unit.box = the bounding box of the unit's copies, its bottom lowered to the lowest rotated-bounds corner (the never-below-the-floor lift leaves every settled copy alone). unit.bin = the drawer, unit.item = the kind it is for (one kind per drawer).
fill_order: 64 packets: 54 across the twelve homes, ten across the two reserves. Reassign a drawer only as a whole; keep each kind's supported copy prefix.
spare_note: Ten real inventory display packets in two reserves. Select the real owner's per-drawer layout; no fixed demo contents.

drawer_layouts_doc: Alternatives, not additive capacity: 12 accepted item kinds x14 physical drawers. Each alternative has that drawer's 4/5 inventory packets. Bounds-centre position+offset; XYZW quaternion; fit_longest_m applied once. Select ONLY actual owned kinds. Keep packet/copy prefix order, never borrow a different item's coordinates. Base units_list spare copies intentionally empty. Suitable source heaps use translation and prefix truncation, preserving same-kind support dependencies. Shorter drawers that cannot accept enough original copies have separately simulated supported prefixes; see checks.new_borrow_settlements. All201 home copies remain unchanged.
runtime_requirements: Inventory remains 64, preserve released rows and retrieval.
Allocate all 14 drawers (54 home +10 reserve packets); a single kind must be allowed to borrow all drawers.
Read drawer_layouts_by_item[actual_item][bin] for home, borrowed home and spare alike. Preserve packet prefix order within each drawer.
Full inventory saturates the finite display: scale per-drawer represented stack counts to the allocated packet counts. Partial packet uses a supported copy prefix.
Do not fall back to generic pose substitution when a per-kind drawer layout is absent.
